independent_groups: future_decision_groups (12 unseen scene seeds precommitted in PR24)
synthetic_job_deadline: job release + 45 + 5 * sorted job index; all stages of same job share public deadline
ranking: Existing decision_value.trace_score unfinished/late tick penalties plus terminal_distance; risk arm adds unadjusted expected positive-delay tick cost as per Tang&Wang probabilistic-risk scheduling, no tuned coefficient

transport risk probability is not calibrated full delay duration
world-model scoring uses an approximate 5 tick horizon, not full optimal planning
